articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M Revenue in Q3 2026, Swings to Loss
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment, one of the largest FEC and bowling-anchored entertainment operators in North America, reported Q3 2026 revenue of $302.64 million but recorded a per-share loss of $0.21. The results offer a key financial benchmark for FEC operators tracking how large-scale venue chains are performing in the current consumer spending environment. Investors and operators should watch margin pressure trends as operating costs remain elevated across the sector.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case Study to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Design firm ESAC is drawing on the Shanghai WUNPARK project to illustrate a major shift in FEC strategy: moving from pure attraction-mix venues toward social destinations that prioritize dwell time, community, and experience layering. The case study highlights how operators can rethink floor plans, programming, and F&B integration to compete in a market where guests expect more than rides and games. This is essential reading for any FEC owner planning a build-out or renovation in the next two years.

articles.title: Level99 Sets Opening Date for West Hartford Location
articles.summary: Level99, the adult social gaming playground concept from Matt DuPlessie's Level99 Entertainment, has announced an opening date for its West Hartford, Connecticut venue. The expansion continues the brand's rapid growth following its high-profile Disney Springs opening earlier in 2026. Each new Level99 location serves as a proof-of-concept for the competitive socializing model that many FEC operators are watching closely.

articles.title: Matt DuPlessie of Level99 Named Among Blooloop's Top Immersive Influencers for 2026
articles.summary: Level99 founder and CEO Matt DuPlessie, whose brand combines physical and mental challenges with technology and F&B, is recognized on the blooloop 50 Immersive Influencer List for 2026. His Disney Springs venue marks the concept's most ambitious expansion yet and signals growing mainstream acceptance of the adult social gaming FEC model. FEC operators can look to Level99's format as a blueprint for high-repeat-visit, experience-layered venues.

articles.title: TwinkleTwinkleStar and Ventola Projects Partner to Turn Party Rooms Into Revenue-Generating Attractions
articles.summary: TwinkleTwinkleStar has announced a collaboration with UK-based Ventola Projects to integrate interactive LED lighting, wireless audio, and video display systems into FEC party rooms. The partnership targets a traditionally underutilized revenue area, transforming party spaces into immersive, bookable entertainment environments. FEC operators looking to increase per-visit spend and party package pricing should take note of this turnkey solution.

articles.title: KWICKFUN Launches Mobile-First Tap & Pay Platform for Attraction Operators
articles.summary: KWICKFUN's new mobile app consolidates admissions, access control, payments, and guest services into a single handheld device, eliminating the need for fixed readers and dedicated networking at every attraction point. The platform supports both credit/debit cards and house game card payments from the same device, potentially reducing infrastructure costs significantly for smaller and mid-sized FECs. Operators evaluating POS and access control upgrades should evaluate this as a flexible, scalable alternative.

articles.title: BrushBoarding Brings Waterless Surf Attraction to IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: BrushBoarding, a waterless surfing attraction designed for FECs, leisure venues, and brand activations, will present a full-size ramp at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando this November. The attraction is positioned as a competitive socializing draw that promotes fitness, skill-building, and repeat visits as guests work to improve their balance and technique. FEC operators attending IAAPA can demo the experience firsthand at booth W1058.

articles.title: Blue Motion Games Brings John Wick: Continental Pursuit Arcade Attraction to IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Blue Motion Games will debut John Wick: Continental Pursuit at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando after a successful summer launch at a major US chain and a European debut at IAAPA Expo Europe. The attraction features 3DOF motion seats, force-feedback blasters, a 75-inch HD screen, and in-seat effects including surround sound and wind, delivering a highly immersive arcade experience. FEC operators looking for licensed IP-driven motion attractions should visit the booth for a live demonstration.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Expanding at South Plains Mall with Large-Scale Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is adding a major family entertainment center to its South Plains Mall location, reflecting the broader trend of cinema operators diversifying into multi-attraction FEC formats to drive foot traffic and compete with streaming. The expansion signals continued momentum for cinema-FEC hybrid models as mall landlords and theater operators seek new ways to anchor retail destinations. FEC suppliers and designers should track this conversion trend as a growing pipeline of projects.

articles.title: 'Masha and the Three Bears' IP Enters FEC Space with First Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: The popular children's animated brand 'Masha and the Three Bears' is launching its first branded family entertainment center, expanding the growing trend of IP-driven FEC concepts targeting young families. The move highlights how content brands outside the traditional Disney and Nickelodeon ecosystem are now actively pursuing location-based entertainment as a revenue channel. FEC developers and operators with available retail or mall space may find this an attractive licensing opportunity.

articles.title: Complete Sports and Management India Wins Two New FEC Projects
articles.summary: India-listed Complete Sports and Management (BSE: CSML) has secured contracts for two new family entertainment center projects, underscoring the accelerating growth of the FEC sector in emerging Asian markets. The wins add to the company's development pipeline and reflect rising consumer demand for organized indoor entertainment in India. International FEC suppliers and attraction manufacturers should view India as an increasingly active procurement market.

articles.title: Wisconsin Bowling Alley Reborn: Community Nostalgia Drives FEC Revival
articles.summary: A historic bowling alley in Ozaukee County, Wisconsin is being revived driven by community demand and the fond memories locals hold for the venue, illustrating how emotional connection to bowling as a shared social experience continues to underpin new investment in the category. The story is a useful reminder that bowling remains one of the most resilient FEC anchors, particularly in smaller markets. Operators considering bowling as a core or secondary attraction should note the strong community sentiment driving this reopening.

articles.title: Pensacola's New 'The Pelican' Indoor Entertainment Complex Opens
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment complex called The Pelican has opened in Pensacola, Florida, adding another multi-attraction venue to the Gulf Coast market. Details suggest the venue is designed to capture both local residents and the region's tourism traffic, particularly during weather-driven demand periods. FEC operators in coastal tourist markets can study this opening as a case study in positioning indoor entertainment as an all-weather destination.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Expands Experience Business, Names Kevin Kreczko Chief Growth Officer
articles.summary: Memoir Creative, a destination and experience creation company, is expanding its client services to serve theme parks, cruise lines, and entertainment venues, and has appointed Kevin Kreczko — formerly of RWS Global and Bass Pro Shops — as Chief Growth Officer. The company's integrated creative, fabrication, production, and operations capabilities position it as a full-service partner for FEC operators planning major experience builds or seasonal events. This expansion adds another well-resourced vendor to the FEC design and production ecosystem.

articles.title: Registration Opens for Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027 in San Antonio
articles.summary: International Ride Training (IRT) has opened registration for Ride Camp Safety Conference 2027, taking place February 1–5 in San Antonio, Texas, billing it as a premier safety education and professional development event for the amusement and water park industry. FEC operators who run any ride-based attractions — including go-karts, trampolines, or mechanical rides — should consider attending to stay current on safety standards and staff training best practices. Early registration is recommended as spots may be limited.

articles.title: Merlin Entertainments Rolling Out Virtual Queue Accessibility System Across Its Attractions in 2027
articles.summary: Merlin Entertainments will update its Ride Access Pass (RAP) system in 2027 to allow guests with accessibility needs to queue virtually via a mobile app, reducing time spent waiting in physical queues. While the rollout is at Merlin venues, the technology and guest experience design approach will set a new standard of expectation that FEC operators with any queue-based attractions should be aware of. Improving accessibility experiences is increasingly a differentiator for family venues competing for the broadest possible audience.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks Extends BBC Earth Partnership, Developing Two New 4D Experiences
articles.summary: SimEx-Iwerks has renewed its long-term licensing deal with BBC Studios and is developing two new 4D Experiences based on the BBC's acclaimed Mammals series, available to license worldwide from March 2027. The content offers FEC and attraction operators with theater-style venues a fresh, premium natural history title backed by a globally recognized brand. Operators running 4D or immersive cinema attractions should evaluate this new content for their 2027 programming slate.

articles.title: SimEx-Iwerks and BBC Studios Announce New 4D Experience Licensing Opportunity
articles.summary: Following the extended partnership between SimEx-Iwerks and BBC Studios, two new 4D Experiences inspired by the Mammals series will be available for licensing beginning March 2027. FEC and attraction venues with existing 4D theater infrastructure can add premium BBC-branded content to their lineup with relatively low capital investment. This is a timely programming opportunity for operators looking to refresh their content offerings heading into the summer 2027 season.

articles.title: Beloit Pub Adds Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit, Wisconsin has installed indoor golf simulators to generate revenue and foot traffic during slower winter months, reflecting the rapidly growing trend of simulator-based entertainment in hospitality and FEC hybrid venues. Golf simulators have emerged as a high-margin, space-efficient attraction that pairs well with F&B, making them an accessible add-on for existing FEC operators or bar-and-entertainment venues. Operators looking for lower-cost attraction additions with strong repeat visit potential should consider the simulator category.

articles.title: EAG360 Launches Best of Show Awards for January 2027 Show
articles.summary: EAG360, the international entertainment, amusements, and gaming trade event, has launched a Best of Show Awards program open to exhibitors across its Amuse Expo, CompSocUK, and London Gaming Show components, with winners announced live on the floor in January 2027. The awards specifically include a category for competitive socializing venue technology, making this relevant for FEC suppliers showcasing interactive experiences, booking platforms, and venue management systems. Entries close December 18, 2026.

articles.title: Bob Cooney, Laser Tag Pioneer and VR Advocate, Named to Blooloop Immersive Influencer List
articles.summary: Bob Cooney, founder of Laser Storm and now executive director of the Location-Based Entertainment XR Association (LEXRA), has been recognized on the blooloop 50 Immersive Influencer List for 2026. His career arc from laser tag to location-based VR makes him a uniquely relevant voice for FEC operators navigating the XR attraction landscape. FEC operators evaluating VR or XR attraction investments should follow LEXRA's research and Cooney's market guidance.

articles.title: Hershey Super Sweet Adventure Shows How CPG Brands Can Power Immersive FEC Experiences
articles.summary: Original X Productions' Hershey Super Sweet Adventure demonstrates that consumer packaged goods brands without traditional fictional narratives can still anchor compelling location-based entertainment experiences by leveraging emotional consumer associations as storytelling material. The project, developed around Hershey's candy brands, created an entirely original mythology and walk-through attraction format with strong commercial results. FEC developers and operators seeking brand licensing partnerships beyond entertainment IP should study this model.

articles.title: ISE 2027 Conference Spark Expands to Bigger Venue, Bridging AV Technology and Themed Entertainment
articles.summary: The Spark conference at ISE 2027, taking place February 3–4 at Fira Montjuïc in Barcelona, is moving to a larger venue to accommodate growing interest at the intersection of AV technology and themed entertainment design. FEC operators and suppliers interested in cutting-edge projection, display, and audio-visual systems for immersive venues will find ISE 2027 a valuable sourcing and education event. The expanded format signals that the overlap between pro-AV and location-based entertainment is becoming a mainstream industry focus.

articles.title: Futuroscope's La Serre des Mondes Demonstrates Gamified Walkthrough Attraction Design
articles.summary: Moment Factory and Futuroscope have transformed a legacy 360-degree projection building into La Serre des Mondes, a 16.5-minute multisensory walkthrough attraction that replaces passive viewing with gamified, participatory activities for groups of 60–80 visitors per cycle, opening February 2026. The project is a strong case study in how FEC and attraction operators can repurpose existing physical infrastructure into high-throughput, repeatable immersive experiences. Designers and operators planning new walkthrough or escape room-style formats should study the narrative architecture and pacing of this project.

articles.title: Fun Spot America Launches Black Friday Season Pass Sale for 2027
articles.summary: Fun Spot America's Orlando and Kissimmee parks are running a Black Friday promotion from November 13–30 offering discounted 2027 season passes and ultimate season passes. The campaign is a useful reference point for FEC operators evaluating their own holiday-period pass sales strategies and promotional timing. Early season pass sales are a proven cash flow tool heading into slower winter months.

articles.title: Play Culture's Linda Dong on Bringing IP-Driven FECs to Asian Markets
articles.summary: Linda Dong, founder of Play Culture, has been recognized on the blooloop 50 Immersive Influencer List for her work developing Nickelodeon and Peppa Pig-branded indoor family entertainment centers across China. Her background in finance and real estate lending gives her a distinctive perspective on the commercial viability of branded FEC concepts in high-growth Asian markets. FEC developers and IP licensors eyeing Asia-Pacific expansion will find Dong's portfolio and insights highly instructive.
